items.summary: A Toronto man was arrested Friday in connection with a break-in that occurred in East York earlier this month, according to police. Investigators were called to the area of Pape and Cosburn Avenues at approximately 2:45 a.m. on Nov. 11, for reports of a man who broke into a local business.

items.title: Who killed Billy Hall? Retired Ontario lawyer probes 1967 murder of teen
items.summary: William (Billy) Hall was just 16 when he moved from North Sydney, N.S., to Ontario in late 1966 seeking better economic opportunities, as many of his siblings had before him. Within less than a year, he was murdered. A retired Ontario lawyer is now trying to find the lead that breaks the case.
